mapper.select: SELECT id FROM carts WHERE member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ci.id, ci.cart_id, ci.product_id, ci.quantity, ci.created_at, ci.updated_at FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN carts c ON c.id = ci.cart_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC, ci.id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ci.quantity), 0) FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN carts c ON c.id = ci.cart_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (cart_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE ci FROM cart_items ci INNER JOIN carts c ON c.id = ci.cart_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId}
